Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 02/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 40 as introduced and as amended and reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education exempts the Alabama School of Fine Arts Foundation and the Alabama High School of Mathematics and Science Foundation from any state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes, which based upon historical data, would decrease sales and use tax receipts by the following estimated amounts annually:
Alabama School of Fine Arts Foundation:
Education Trust Fund
$6,125
County Funds
$1,531
Municipal Funds
$6,125
Total
$13,781
Alabama High School of Mathematics and Science Foundation:
Education Trust Fund
$7,566
County Funds
$2,837
Municipal Funds
$9,457
Total
$19,860
This bill also exempts the Alabama School of Cyber Technology and Engineering Foundation from paying any state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes, which would also decrease, by an undetermined amount, sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund, county funds and municipal funds.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Date: 03/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 40 as passed the Senate exempts the Alabama School of Fine Arts Foundation, Incorporated, the Alabama High School of Mathematics and Science Foundation, and the Alabama School of Cyber Technology and Engineering Foundation from paying any state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes. Based on historical data, this bill would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the following estimated amounts annually for the entities listed:
Alabama School of Fine Arts Foundation:
Education Trust Fund
$2,240
County Funds
$560
Municipal Funds
$2,240
Total
$5,040
Alabama High School of Mathematics and Science Foundation
Education Trust Fund
$7,600
County Funds
$2,850
Municipal Funds
$9,500
Total
$19,950
Further, based on information provided, this bill would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the following estimated amounts for the Alabama School of Cyber Technology and Engineering Foundation due to an ongoing capital project:
Education Trust Fund
$460,000
County Funds
$57,500
Municipal Funds
$517,500
Total
$1,035,000
Bill Poole, Chair
Ways and Means Education
